subject: Recurring payment failures — propose SEPA invoice option to avoid chargeback
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@ecomify.com>
Cc: billing@ecomify.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Failed card attempts on INV-202606 — next steps to avoid service interruption

Hi Liam,

Quick note — Stripe reported three failed attempts to charge the card on file for invoice INV-202606 (monthly subscription, EUR). Decline code returned: card_decline / insufficient_funds on the last attempt. The attached PDF is the invoice we just retried.

We want to avoid a potential dispute or chargeback. Options we can move forward with immediately:
- You can update the card via the customer portal (link below) and we can retry once more (low-friction).
- If cards are unreliable for this account, we can issue a SEPA pro-forma invoice (one-off bank transfer) or switch to SEPA Direct Debit for future cycles.

If you prefer a bank transfer, tell me whether you need:
- an invoice showing our VAT number and Ecomify's billing address (Net30), or
- a SEPA mandate form for recurring pulls (we can auto-generate).

If we don't hear back by EOD Friday we'll pause retries to avoid additional declines and escalate to collections — but we can avoid that if you tell us which path you want.

Attachment: invoice-INV-202606.pdf (PDF, 98KB)
Customer portal: https://billing.redwood.com/portal/ecomify

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the heads up. Finance is seeing a VAT ID mismatch on our side which is blocking the cardholder from authorizing the payment today. We definitely want to avoid a chargeback — they're costly and slow.

We can do a one-off SEPA transfer for this invoice. Please send a pro-forma with Ecomify's billing name and VAT details (I'll attach a copy of our VAT cert when I have it). Also send your IBAN and beneficiary details for the transfer.

If possible, please don't escalate retries; we want a clean single payment rather than multiple declines.

— Liam
